meaning: 对某人的判断是正确的
usageNote: 口语超常用！当你说'我早看穿他了'就用这个，带点小得意的感觉✨

examples.en: I was right about him — he never keeps his promises.
examples.zh: 我对他的判断没错——他从来不守承诺。

examples.en: You were right about Sarah. She really is the most hardworking person on the team.
examples.zh: 你对Sarah的判断是对的，她真的是团队里最努力的人。
